sources.title: Visa requirements for entering the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The North Macedonian MFA publishes current entry and visa conditions on its official mfa.gov.mk consular-services domain, including the directly stated EU/Schengen exemption and 2026 document-conditioned routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of EU Member States and signatories of the Schengen Agreement DO NOT need a visa.

sources.title: Constitution of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The Official Gazette publishes the constitutional text. Article 27 protects every citizen's right to return, while the Ministry of Justice's current legislative register indexes the Constitution.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A citizen cannot be expelled from the Republic; every citizen has the right to return.

sources.title: Constitution: current legislative register
sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry of Justice's official legislative database provides the current register record for the Constitution and its Gazette publication history.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Constitution of the Republic of Macedonia

sources.title: Do you need a visa?
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The MFA operates the current regional country-selection checker on its official mfa.gov.mk consular-services domain.

sources.title: Consolidated Law on Foreigners
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior of the Republic of North Macedonia / Official Gazette
sources.officialityEvidence: The Interior Ministry hosts the consolidated Official Gazette text of the Law on Foreigners, including the statutory definition and Government-regulation basis for the visa regime.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Визен режим ... е листа на држави чии државјани ... се изземени од таа обврска.

sources.publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of North Macedonia

policies.title: North Macedonian ordinary passport: citizenship and constitutional return
policies.summary: A North Macedonian citizen has a constitutional right to return and is classified as citizenship rather than under the foreign-visitor visa regime.
conditions: This is a citizenship classification supported by the constitutional right to return; it does not determine document formalities for a dual national presenting another passport.
Residence, work, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, emergency-document and final border-control treatment remain outside this classification.

policies.title: EU and Schengen ordinary passports: visa-free entry
policies.summary: The current MFA entry page directly exempts nationals of EU Member States and Schengen signatories from an entry visa.
conditions: The MFA additionally permits these nationals to enter with a valid national identity card; this policy records the ordinary-passport relationship only.

A qualifying EU/Schengen residence permit or multiple-entry Schengen C visa can create a separate 15-day route for other travellers. A temporary 2026 decision creates a similar document-conditioned route for qualifying multiple-entry US, UK or Canadian visas. Neither route expands this nationality cohort.
Document validity, purpose, funds, registration, public-order and final-admission requirements remain applicable; work, residence and special travel documents are outside this policy.
